name: Who Killed The Streamer?
detailed_description:
Who Killed The Streamer is an exciting mystery and investigation game where players assume the role of a detective who has to solve the murder of a famous streamer. The streamer mysteriously disappeared a few months ago without a trace.

Thus, you, as the detective who will solve the case, must investigate the house where the streamer was staying to look for clues that tell you what happened.

  • Go through the house and look for clues.
  • Use the clues to progress through the story.
  • Infiltrate the computer to see what the streamer was hiding on their computer.
  • There may be people who don't agree with this coming to light, so be quick and run away as soon as you can.

In this narrative game, the aim is for the player to experience a story of tension and mystery 'Escape Room' style.
